name: roomline.search
description: Search hotels in a city for check_in to check_out (local dates at the hotel). Every hotel is listed with both rate plans, Free cancellation and Non-refundable, with nightly price, total, availability and terms. Prices are in euro cents. Reading changes nothing.

name: roomline.book
description: Book one room at a hotel for check_in to check_out on a rate plan, paid with a saved payment label. Both plans are charged in full at booking. The result gives the reservation status: confirmed, or pending_rate_switch when the hotel asks to move the stay to its non-refundable rate (see roomline.rate_switch.confirm and .decline).

name: roomline.cancel
description: Cancel a reservation. Refunds follow the plan at the current time: Free cancellation refunds in full until its deadline and keeps the first night after it; Non-refundable refunds nothing. Cancellation closes at arrival. A pending rate-switch offer is withdrawn.
